reviewer: separate assistant task os_automatic_review; not independent certification

findings.problem: Prepared SBOM was not required to equal deterministic derivation of the authenticated baseline SBOM.
findings.resolution: assertPreparedBinding now compares the complete decoded SBOM with rebindSbom of the authenticated baseline; altered components, metadata and provenance are rejected.

findings.problem: Prepared archive parser interpreted PAX before explicit raw extension and expanded-size bounds.
findings.resolution: Imported raw_headers validates size/count/PAX first; exact metadata/schema, canonical members, path-only PAX and unchanged input are checked. Oversized declared PAX is rejected before destination creation.

conclusions: Signed baseline and independently pinned public key are required before deriving a candidate.
Application, catalog and host source bytes/modes remain bound to the authenticated baseline; only three Node files and derived SBOM/build record may differ.
New native evidence is mandatory and binds current source, exact Node version, app inventory and complete build-record digest before private-key reading/signing.
Unsigned transport alone never authorizes signing or privileged installation; baseline, preparation and native gates are reapplied.
limits: No actual future Node release archive exists in this task; no end-to-end future Node candidate, signature, release publication or Pi update was performed.
Tests use synthetic Node version labels where necessary and actual prior SBOM metadata; they are not execution of a future Node version.
Existing native validator performs native x64 management checks; ARM64 Pi and physical-system acceptance remain separate.
